idea-plugin.name: Sproto Language
idea-plugin.description:
Features

Author: Yexiao.

  • Native Sproto support for JetBrains Rider: syntax highlighting, scoped and cross-file type navigation.
  • Separate colors for type declarations/references, field declarations/dictionary keys, protocols, built-in types, numbers and punctuation.
  • GUI color and font settings under Editor → Color Scheme → Sproto, with theme inheritance.
  • White fields, blue built-in types and light-yellow protocol method names (#DCDCAA) by default; numbers inherit the theme.
  • Contextual completion, type/field documentation, protocol templates and line comments.
  • Syntax and type diagnostics for unknown/ambiguous types, duplicate names/tags, dictionary keys and fixed-point precision.
  • Nested types, arrays, dictionaries, fixed-point integers, inline request/response bodies and response nil.

References

  • Sproto Schema Language
  • IntelliJ Custom Language Support
  • JetBrains Color Scheme Management

Generation
